claim: Try it with sample data opens a stocked pantry in a separate, resettable space.
sandbox: fresh browser context; open /demo through the landing action; reset the sample; assert only demo:pantry-check exists

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context; open /demo; wait for the service worker; set context offline; reload; assert sample data remains visible

claim: Pantry data stays on this device; normal use makes no third-party or cross-origin application requests.
where: landing facts, footer, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; use the demo check while collecting requests; assert same-origin only and that data uses demo:pantry-check

claim: Exports the shopping list as CSV.
sandbox: fresh browser context; open /demo; export its seeded shopping list; assert the downloaded header and item row
fresh browser context; open /demo; download with a passphrase; assert the file excludes the sample item and passphrase plaintext

claim: Pantry Check does not send or save the backup passphrase, so it cannot recover the passphrase.
sandbox: fresh browser context; create a demo backup while recording requests; inspect localStorage, sessionStorage, and every IndexedDB store; assert the passphrase is absent

claim: A service-worker update appears in the app and can be installed with Reload to update.
sandbox: fresh browser context and isolated local server; install worker version one; serve version two; assert the prompt appears and activating it replaces the worker cache
